Open WLS App to Order Wire


  1. Loan Setup – Add/Edit
  2. Import (bottom of screen) – Browse and import Saved FNM 3.2 file.
  3. Account number – ARIVE Loan number
  4. Branch – Leave Blank
  5. Request Date – Date of Funding **Important
  6. Product Code – Select per Loan
  7. Investor – Select per investor
  8. Closing Agent – Select agent as list compiled (Unassigned if not available)


SAVE (In Top Right Corner)

Choose Translation Type – Full Doc

Appraisal Type – Usually 1004 Full, 1025 Condo or PIW

Select OK – And close sub box


Select “Find” in lower left – Double Click loan to populate in edit mode

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
1. Confirm All Information – Product, Note/Loan Amount, Rate, Term,
  2. Confirm Requested date is actual Funding Date **Important
  3. Press FTS button (Funds to Send) – Enter the amount of Total Funds to Send on the Wire Breakdown XML Form. Confirm haircut amount (if applicable) matches that on the XML Wire Breakdown form
  4. Complete MERS in center section– Copy from EASE
  5. Input Investor Lock Expiration Date – Right side
  6. Input Takeout based on Lock Confirmation

Save (bottom right)

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue

1. Complete Rate Type Section based on Loan info (Left Side)
  2. Check Appraised Value, Sales Price, and LTV in center section
  3. Enter Credit Score – Top right from loan info

Save (bottom right)

componentInstanceProperties.name: richTextValue
componentInstanceProperties.value:
1. Upload Funding Requirement documents into WLS
  2. Select – ADD and upload documents
    1. CPL
    2. UW Approval Letter
    3. Lock Confirmation
    4. Wiring Instructions
    5. UCLOSE 2.0
  3. Snip at 100%
  4. Select Status Drop Down in top Right Corner and Select Submitted and Save

Wire is now Requested


Complete Shipping Request Immediately

  1. Select Collateral – Note Ship Request
  2. Find Loan (bottom Left)
  3. Select Loan
  4. Highlight Investor selection
  5. Select Add Note Ship Request

From Simmons WLS App

  • Select Transaction
  • Select Purchase Advice
  • Select Add button on right side of Screen
  • Enter Total Wire Amount provided on the Purchase Advice from Investor
  • Select the Investor from the drop down
  • Select OK
  • Press ADD Image buttom and upload the Purchase Advice PDF from Investor
  • Highlight file in Lower Loans Section and select ADD to the right of that Section


Purchase Advice Request is complete
